# KumbhDoot (कुंभदूत)

> World's First AI Agent Framework for a Mass Gathering (Nashik Kumbh Mela 2027)

## Overview
KumbhDoot is an agentic AI framework designed to empower over 50 million pilgrims during the Nashik Simhastha Kumbh Mela in 2027. It provides an "AI Doot for Every Pilgrim" — a voice-first, multilingual personal assistant running on edge devices and smartphones that ensures real-time crowd safety, cultural navigation, health services, transit coordination, and dignity of life without continuous cloud dependence.

## Key Leadership & Organizations
- **Government of Maharashtra**: Overseeing Nashik Kumbh Mela 2027 Authority
- **Kaustubh Dhavse**: Chief Advisor to CM, Maharashtra
- **Dr. Praveen Gedam**: Divisional Commissioner, Nashik
- **Shekhar Singh**: Commissioner of Kumbh Mela, Nashik
- **Prof. Ramesh Raskar**: MIT Media Lab / Founder, Project NANDA & Kumbha Labs
- **Official R&D Labs**: [Kumbha Labs](https://kumbhlabs.org)
- **Initiative Partner**: [Project NANDA](https://www.projectnanda.org)

## Core Architecture Pillars
1. **Agentic AI & Swarm Coordination**: Autonomous personal AI agents coordinated with civic and emergency services.
2. **Edge-First & Offline Resilience**: Local processing on edge devices and mesh-networked kiosks to handle extreme telecom network congestion.
3. **Multilingual Voice-First Interface**: Real-time voice translation across 15+ Indian languages and global dialects.
4. **Zero-Knowledge Privacy**: Privacy-preserving location and credential verification without mass surveillance.
5. **Universal Service Integration**: Unified transit, darshan booking, crowd heatmaps, medical aid, and lost-and-found registry.

## Key Events & Milestones
- **Kumbhathon Innovation S.P.R.I.N.T. 2026**: 3-day living lab with Prof. Ramesh Raskar in Nashik (Sep 5–7, 2026).
- **MIT Media Lab Summit**: Global mass gathering AI architecture symposium at Cambridge, MA.
- **IIT Delhi Strategic Roundtable**: Public-private AI architecture alignment with national experts.
- **Davos World Economic Forum**: Presentation on scalable digital public infrastructure for 50M+ citizen events.
